as_told.title: Mysterious man with 'googly eyes' who quizzed Drumm about the Serapeum and then vanished

plain: A man named Geoffrey Drumm says that on his first trip to Egypt, around 2017, he sat down to dinner with a man, at a hotel in one version, whose big bulging eyes looked like a chameleon's and seemed to move on their own, one looking off elsewhere. He says the man questioned him about the Serapeum, an ancient underground site in Egypt, and that when Drumm later tried to message him, the man had vanished as if into thin air. Drumm tells it on Jesse Michels' podcast, in an episode about his belief that a non-human being revealed the true purpose of the pyramids to him.
